meta.name: score-covariance-estimate
meta.description: Score and compare covariance estimates with precise's assessor panel. Use when you need to judge an estimate out-of-sample or rank competing estimators — and especially in high dimensions, where the plain held-out likelihood is misleading.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估和比较协方差估计量的表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要评估或比较不同协方差估计方法的准确性。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess or rank covariance estimators.

howto.what: 使用precise库的assessor面板为协方差估计打分并排序，分数越高越好。需要提供测试数据或真实协方差（仅模拟）。
howto.when: 当需要判断协方差估计的样本外表现，或排序多个竞争估计时触发。尤其适合高维数据（维度接近样本量）。

say.text: 用BlockPseudoLikelihood评一下这个协方差估计。
用LogLikelihood评估这个低维协方差。

howto.what_en: Use precise's assessor panel to score and rank covariance estimates. Higher scores are better. Provide test data or true covariance (simulation only).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to judge out-of-sample performance of a covariance estimate or rank multiple estimators. Especially useful in high dimensions (p close to n).

say_en.text: Score this covariance estimate with BlockPseudoLikelihood.
Compare cov1 and cov2 using FrobeniusToTruth.
Evaluate this low-dim covariance with LogLikelihood.
